newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank rev repo tender fails to attract bids.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank rev repo tender fails to attract bids.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday its tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase had failed to attract any bids.
Peter Andresic, head of the NBS Open Market Operation Department, told Reuters that local banks appeared short of liquidity, resulting in a lack of interest in the tender.
But, he added, the central bank would stick to its sterilising efforts since it still expected a "larger" liquidity inflow.
In Wednesday's reverse repo tender with a similar maturity, the NBS rejected all bids totalling 450 million crowns due to higher than acceptable bid rates.
Slovak short-term interbank money market rates continued to rise in early Thursday activity, with average overnight offer rates rising by some 100 basis points from Wednesday to 21.81 percent.
